name: codex-worker-delegation
description: OAuth-safe Codex Main routing with provider-isolated Worker/Verifier execution and live model capability discovery.

interface.longDescription: Keep an authenticated ChatGPT Main on the official provider, discover model-specific reasoning capabilities live, and route Worker/Verifier work through official native subagents or explicit provider-isolated App Server threads. OFFICIAL mode stays dormant so the installed Codex runtime owns its native defaults.
defaultPrompt: If mode is OFFICIAL, follow native Codex behavior and do not force plugin-managed delegation.
Use native subagents only for built-in OpenAI routes. Use delegate_worker for every configured route involving a third-party provider.
